project.title: Vampire: The Masquerade Character Creator
project.summary: A browser-based Vampire: The Masquerade V5 creator for standard-clan neonates and newly Embraced fledglings with a live rules ledger, local drafts, and printable sheets.

items.title: Add standard-clan ancilla creation
items.notes: Extend the age profiles with Core ancilla Generation, Blood Potency, Humanity, and starting budgets. Verify a hand-checked ancilla build, starting XP purchase order, and how the guide handles selections affected by a profile change.

items.title: Add Caitiff creation
items.notes: Add Caitiff as a distinct choice alongside clan, with source-cited Discipline selection, costs, and restrictions. Verify a hand-checked Caitiff build through review, print, and backup restore.

items.title: Add Thin-blood creation
items.notes: Add source-cited Thin-blood restrictions and starting choices, including applicable Merits, Flaws, and Alchemy choices. Verify a hand-checked fixture through review, print, and restore, and check that unsupported combinations are clearly identified.

items.title: Add an opt-in Player’s Guide source pack
items.notes: Start with a documented set of Player’s Guide options and the prerequisites, grants, and choices required to finish those builds. Tag each option with its source and preserve Core-only results. Verify a mixed-source fixture and show unavailable sources in backup and build-link previews.

items.title: Add a post-creation XP advancement journal
items.notes: Start from a finished character and track earned XP, ordered purchases, and remaining XP separately from starting allocations. Verify dependent purchases, undo or removal, reload, and a backup round-trip with a hand-checked advancement fixture.
